_doc: Default take-check thresholds. Pass this file with --config, or copy the keys under a top-level take_check object in a client's reel-style.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Missing keys fall back to these defaults. Every number here is a threshold, not a measurement. fillers_per_min_max, low_confidence_max, longest_pause_s, and hook_max_s are soft (yellow). min_speech_s and min_words are hard (red / silent). pause_s is the gap that counts as a pause. low_word_prob is the word probability below which a word is low-confidence. no_speech_prob_min: a take is silent when every segment is above this. fillers is the phrase list (do not add 'like'). setup_cues are slate words matched only in the first setup_window_s. silence_phrases are whole-text hallucinations, not substrings. prefixes are folder-scan stem prefixes (--prefix overrides, --all ignores). judge_cmd is the argv of the model judge; the prompt is written to stdin unless an element contains {prompt}. judge_timeout_s and jobs bound the judge.
